items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: But was that Tyree Glenn you were talking about?

ctx.x: I think so. That's what I heard. And you were saying -- you mentioned to me the other day the trombone player who came in after Tricky Sam, or did the same parts, and you
couldn't think of his name. But was that Tyree Glenn you were talking about?
No, that was White, I think. He came in there and played for awhile. I think now, I don't know.
